announcementBannerConfig.text:
We wish to inform you that the online payment platform for trade fees currently supports transactions only using National ID (NID) numbers.

At this time, the system does not support payments using passport numbers. Therefore, non-citizens are required to make all trade fee payments in person at the CBRD office until further notice.

We acknowledge the inconvenience this may cause and sincerely appreciate your patience, understanding, and cooperation.
